doc.dbt.__overview__.block_contents:
### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.

---

### More information

- [What is dbt](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/introduction)?
- Read the [dbt viewpoint](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/viewpoint)
- [Installation](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/installation)
- Join the [dbt Community](https://www.getdbt.com/community/) for questions and discussion

macro.dbt_duckdb.duckdb__get_catalog.macro_sql:
{% macro duckdb__get_catalog(information_schema, schemas) -%}
  {%- call statement('catalog', fetch_result=True) -%}
    with relations AS (
      select
        t.table_name
        , t.database_name
        , t.schema_name
        , 'BASE TABLE' as table_type
        , {{ adapter.catalog_comment('t') }} as table_comment
      from duckdb_tables() t
      WHERE t.database_name = '{{ database }}'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT v.view_name as table_name
      , v.database_name
      , v.schema_name
      , 'VIEW' as table_type
      , {{ adapter.catalog_comment('v') }} as table_comment
      from duckdb_views() v
      WHERE v.database_name = '{{ database }}'
    )
    select
        '{{ database }}' as table_database,
        r.schema_name as table_schema,
        r.table_name,
        r.table_type,
        r.table_comment,
        c.column_name,
        c.column_index as column_index,
        c.data_type as column_type,
        {{ adapter.catalog_comment('c') }} as column_comment,
        '' as table_owner
    FROM relations r JOIN duckdb_columns() c ON r.schema_name = c.schema_name AND r.table_name = c.table_name
    WHERE (
        {%- for schema in schemas -%}
          upper(r.schema_name) = upper('{{ schema }}'){%- if not loop.last %} or {% endif -%}
        {%- endfor -%}
    )
    ORDER BY
        r.schema_name,
        r.table_name,
        c.column_index
  {%- endcall -%}
  {{ return(load_result('catalog').table) }}
{%- endmacro %}

macro.dbt_duckdb.duckdb__list_relations_.macro_sql:
{% macro duckdb__list_relations_without_caching(schema_relation) %}
  {% call statement('list_relations_without_caching', fetch_result=True) -%}
    select
      '{{ schema_relation.database }}' as database,
      table_name as name,
      table_schema as schema,
      CASE table_type
        WHEN 'BASE TABLE' THEN 'table'
        WHEN 'VIEW' THEN 'view'
        WHEN 'LOCAL TEMPORARY' THEN 'table'
        END as type
    from system.information_schema.tables
    where lower(table_schema) = '{{ schema_relation.schema | lower }}'
    and lower(table_catalog) = '{{ schema_relation.database | lower }}'
  {% endcall %}
  {{ return(load_result('list_relations_without_caching').table) }}
{% endmacro %}

model.jaffle_shop.dim_customers.description: One row per customer, with their order history: first and latest order, number of orders, lifetime spend, and whether they have ordered more than once.
model.jaffle_shop.dim_customers.name: dim_customers
model.jaffle_shop.dim_customers.raw_code:
with customers as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_customers') }}
),

history as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_customer_order_history') }}
)

select
    customers.customer_id,
    customers.customer_name,
    customers.email,
    history.first_ordered_at,
    history.last_ordered_at,
    coalesce(history.order_count, 0) as order_count,
    coalesce(history.lifetime_spend, 0) as lifetime_spend,
    case when history.is_repeat_buyer then 'returning' else 'new' end as customer_type
from customers
left join history on customers.customer_id = history.customer_id

model.jaffle_shop.dim_locations.description: One row per store, with its region from the operations seed.
model.jaffle_shop.dim_locations.name: dim_locations
model.jaffle_shop.dim_locations.raw_code:
with locations as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_locations') }}
),

regions as (
    select * from {{ ref('store_regions') }}
)

select
    locations.location_id,
    locations.location_name,
    regions.region,
    locations.tax_rate,
    locations.opened_on
from locations
left join regions on locations.location_id = regions.store_id

unit_margin.description: Price less the cost of the supplies one unit uses.
unit_margin.name: unit_margin

model.jaffle_shop.dim_products.description: One row per product, with its price, supply cost and margin.
model.jaffle_shop.dim_products.name: dim_products
model.jaffle_shop.dim_products.raw_code:
with products as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_products') }}
),

supply_costs as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_product_supply_costs') }}
)

select
    products.product_id,
    products.product_name,
    products.product_type,
    products.product_price,
    coalesce(supply_costs.supply_cost, 0) as unit_supply_cost,
    products.product_price - coalesce(supply_costs.supply_cost, 0) as unit_margin,
    coalesce(supply_costs.has_perishable_supply, false) as has_perishable_supply
from products
left join supply_costs on products.product_id = supply_costs.product_id

model.jaffle_shop.fct_marketing_spend.description: Ad spend per channel per day.
model.jaffle_shop.fct_marketing_spend.name: fct_marketing_spend
model.jaffle_shop.fct_marketing_spend.raw_code:
select

    channel,
    campaign_name,
    spend_date,
    spend
from {{ ref('stg_ad_spend') }}
where spend > 0

model.jaffle_shop.fct_order_items.description: One row per item sold, with price, cost and margin.
model.jaffle_shop.fct_order_items.name: fct_order_items
model.jaffle_shop.fct_order_items.raw_code:
select
    items.order_item_id,
    items.order_id,
    items.product_id,
    orders.ordered_at,
    items.product_price,
    items.supply_cost,
    items.item_margin
from {{ ref('int_order_items_priced') }} as items
join {{ ref('stg_orders') }} as orders on items.order_id = orders.order_id

order_cost.description: The supply cost of every item on the order.
order_cost.name: order_cost

order_id.description: The order's id in the shop.
order_id.name: order_id

model.jaffle_shop.fct_orders.description: One row per order with its totals, what was paid, and what the items cost to make. The grain for every revenue figure.
model.jaffle_shop.fct_orders.name: fct_orders
model.jaffle_shop.fct_orders.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='incremental', unique_key='order_id') }}

-- One row per order: totals from the shop, what was paid from Stripe, and the
-- supply cost of the items. Incremental on ordered_at.

with orders as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}
    {% if is_incremental() %}
    where ordered_at > (select max(ordered_at) from {{ this }})
    {% endif %}
),

payments as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_order_payments') }}
),

items as (
    select
        order_id,
        count(*) as item_count,
        sum(supply_cost) as order_cost,
        sum(case when is_food_item then 1 else 0 end) as food_item_count,
        sum(case when is_drink_item then 1 else 0 end) as drink_item_count
    from {{ ref('int_order_items_priced') }}
    group by order_id
)

select
    orders.order_id,
    orders.customer_id,
    orders.location_id,
    orders.status,
    orders.ordered_at,
    cast(orders.ordered_at as date) as order_date,
    orders.subtotal,
    orders.tax_paid,
    orders.order_total,
    coalesce(payments.amount_paid, 0) as amount_paid,
    orders.order_total - coalesce(payments.amount_paid, 0) as amount_outstanding,
    items.item_count,
    items.order_cost,
    items.food_item_count > 0 as is_food_order,
    items.drink_item_count > 0 as is_drink_order
from orders
left join payments on orders.order_id = payments.order_id
left join items on orders.order_id = items.order_id

model.jaffle_shop.fct_payments.name: fct_payments
model.jaffle_shop.fct_payments.raw_code:
select
    payment_id,
    order_id,
    payment_method,
    amount,
    paid_at,
    cast(paid_at as date) as paid_date
from {{ ref('stg_payments') }}
where payment_status = 'success'

model.jaffle_shop.int_customer_order_his.name: int_customer_order_history
model.jaffle_shop.int_customer_order_his.raw_code:
-- Each customer's first and latest order, how many orders they have placed and
-- what they have spent. Returned orders do not count.

with orders as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}
    where status != 'returned'
)

select
    customer_id,
    min(ordered_at) as first_ordered_at,
    max(ordered_at) as last_ordered_at,
    count(*) as order_count,
    sum(order_total) as lifetime_spend,
    count(*) > 1 as is_repeat_buyer
from orders
group by customer_id

model.jaffle_shop.int_order_items_priced.name: int_order_items_priced
model.jaffle_shop.int_order_items_priced.raw_code:
-- Each order item with its product's price and the cost of the supplies that
-- go into it, so margin can be worked out per item.

with order_items as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_order_items') }}
),

products as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_products') }}
),

supply_costs as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_product_supply_costs') }}
)

select
    order_items.order_item_id,
    order_items.order_id,
    order_items.product_id,
    products.product_price,
    supply_costs.supply_cost,
    products.product_price - supply_costs.supply_cost as item_margin,
    products.is_food_item,
    products.is_drink_item
from order_items
left join products on order_items.product_id = products.product_id
left join supply_costs on order_items.product_id = supply_costs.product_id

model.jaffle_shop.int_order_payments.name: int_order_payments
model.jaffle_shop.int_order_payments.raw_code:
-- Successful payments summed per order and split by method. Failed attempts
-- are left out.

with payments as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_payments') }}
    where payment_status = 'success'
)

select
    order_id,
    sum(amount) as amount_paid,
    sum(case when payment_method = 'credit_card' then amount else 0 end) as credit_card_amount,
    sum(case when payment_method = 'coupon' then amount else 0 end) as coupon_amount,
    sum(case when payment_method = 'gift_card' then amount else 0 end) as gift_card_amount,
    max(paid_at) as last_paid_at
from payments
group by order_id

model.jaffle_shop.int_product_supply_cos.name: int_product_supply_costs
model.jaffle_shop.int_product_supply_cos.raw_code:
-- The total cost of the supplies one unit of each product uses.

select
    product_id,
    sum(supply_cost) as supply_cost,
    count(*) as supply_count,
    bool_or(is_perishable_supply) as has_perishable_supply
from {{ ref('stg_supplies') }}
group by product_id

model.jaffle_shop.int_sessions_attribute.name: int_sessions_attributed
model.jaffle_shop.int_sessions_attribute.raw_code:
-- Orders credited to the marketing channel of the customer's last web session
-- in the 7 days before the order.

with sessions as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_web_sessions') }}
),

orders as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}
),

joined as (
    select
        orders.order_id,
        orders.order_total,
        sessions.channel,
        row_number() over (partition by orders.order_id order by sessions.started_at desc) as recency_rank
    from orders
    join sessions on orders.customer_id = sessions.customer_id
        and sessions.started_at between orders.ordered_at - interval 7 day and orders.ordered_at
)

select order_id, order_total, channel
from joined
where recency_rank = 1

model.jaffle_shop.rpt_customer_ltv.description: Lifetime value by month of first order (cohort), for the retention review.
model.jaffle_shop.rpt_customer_ltv.name: rpt_customer_ltv
model.jaffle_shop.rpt_customer_ltv.raw_code:
select
    date_trunc('month', first_ordered_at) as cohort_month,
    count(*) as customers,
    sum(lifetime_spend) / nullif(count(*), 0) as average_lifetime_spend,
    sum(case when customer_type = 'returning' then 1 else 0 end) * 1.0 / count(*) as repeat_rate
from {{ ref('dim_customers') }}
where first_ordered_at is not null
group by 1

model.jaffle_shop.rpt_daily_revenue.description: Revenue, orders and margin per store per day. Feeds the finance dashboard.
model.jaffle_shop.rpt_daily_revenue.name: rpt_daily_revenue
model.jaffle_shop.rpt_daily_revenue.raw_code:
select
    orders.order_date,
    locations.location_name,
    locations.region,
    count(*) as order_count,
    sum(orders.order_total) as revenue,
    sum(orders.order_total - orders.tax_paid - orders.order_cost) as gross_margin,
    sum(orders.order_total) / nullif(count(*), 0) as average_order_value
from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} as orders
join {{ ref('dim_locations') }} as locations on orders.location_id = locations.location_id
where orders.status != 'returned'
group by 1, 2, 3

model.jaffle_shop.rpt_marketing_roas.description: Return on ad spend per channel per month.
model.jaffle_shop.rpt_marketing_roas.name: rpt_marketing_roas
model.jaffle_shop.rpt_marketing_roas.raw_code:
with spend as (
    select
        channel,
        date_trunc('month', spend_date) as month,
        sum(spend) as spend
    from {{ ref('fct_marketing_spend') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

revenue as (
    select
        attributed.channel,
        date_trunc('month', orders.ordered_at) as month,
        sum(attributed.order_total) as attributed_revenue
    from {{ ref('int_sessions_attributed') }} as attributed
    join {{ ref('fct_orders') }} as orders on attributed.order_id = orders.order_id
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    spend.channel,
    spend.month,
    spend.spend,
    coalesce(revenue.attributed_revenue, 0) as attributed_revenue,
    coalesce(revenue.attributed_revenue, 0) / nullif(spend.spend, 0) as roas
from spend
left join revenue on spend.channel = revenue.channel and spend.month = revenue.month

model.jaffle_shop.stg_customers.raw_code:
-- Customers as the shop records them: one row per customer.

with source as (
    select * from {{ source('ecom', 'raw_customers') }}
),

renamed as (
    select
        id as customer_id,
        name as customer_name,
        lower(trim(email)) as email,
        cast(created_at as timestamp) as created_at
    from source
)

model.jaffle_shop.stg_order_items.name: stg_order_items

model.jaffle_shop.stg_orders.description: One row per order. Test orders are removed.
model.jaffle_shop.stg_orders.name: stg_orders
model.jaffle_shop.stg_orders.raw_code:
-- Orders placed in store and online. Test orders, made by staff when a store
-- opens, are removed here so they never reach revenue.

with source as (
    select * from {{ source('ecom', 'raw_orders') }}
),

renamed as (
    select
        id as order_id,
        customer as customer_id,
        store_id as location_id,
        lower(status) as status,
        cast(ordered_at as timestamp) as ordered_at,
        subtotal / 100.0 as subtotal,
        tax_paid / 100.0 as tax_paid,
        order_total / 100.0 as order_total
    from source
    where coalesce(is_test, false) = false
)

select * from renamed

model.jaffle_shop.stg_payments.description: One row per Stripe payment attempt, amounts in dollars.
model.jaffle_shop.stg_payments.name: stg_payments
model.jaffle_shop.stg_payments.raw_code:
-- Stripe payment attempts. Amounts arrive in cents; failed attempts are kept
-- here and removed downstream.

with source as (
    select * from {{ source('stripe', 'payments') }}
)

select
    id as payment_id,
    orderid as order_id,
    paymentmethod as payment_method,
    status as payment_status,
    amount / 100.0 as amount,
    cast(created as timestamp) as paid_at
from source

model.jaffle_shop.stg_products.name: stg_products
model.jaffle_shop.stg_products.raw_code:
-- Products on the menu, with the price in dollars and flags for food and drink.

with source as (
    select * from {{ source('ecom', 'raw_products') }}
)

select
    sku as product_id,
    name as product_name,
    type as product_type,
    description as product_description,
    price / 100.0 as product_price,
    type = 'jaffle' as is_food_item,
    type = 'beverage' as is_drink_item
from source

model.jaffle_shop.stg_supplies.description: One row per supply per product. A product uses several supplies.
model.jaffle_shop.stg_supplies.name: stg_supplies
model.jaffle_shop.stg_supplies.raw_code:
with source as (
    select * from {{ source('ecom', 'raw_supplies') }}
)

select
    {{ dbt.concat(['id', "'-'", 'sku']) }} as supply_uuid,
    id as supply_id,
    sku as product_id,
    name as supply_name,
    cost / 100.0 as supply_cost,
    perishable as is_perishable_supply
from source

model.jaffle_shop.stg_web_sessions.name: stg_web_sessions
model.jaffle_shop.stg_web_sessions.raw_code:
with source as (
    select * from {{ source('marketing', 'web_sessions') }}
)

select
    session_id,
    customer_id,
    lower(utm_source) as channel,
    cast(started_at as timestamp) as started_at
from source
where customer_id is not null

test.jaffle_shop.assert_no_negative_dail.name: assert_no_negative_daily_revenue
test.jaffle_shop.assert_no_negative_dail.raw_code:
-- Daily revenue per store is never negative, even after returns.
select *
from {{ ref('rpt_daily_revenue') }}
where revenue < 0

test.jaffle_shop.assert_paid_never_excee.name: assert_paid_never_exceeds_order_total
test.jaffle_shop.assert_paid_never_excee.raw_code:
-- An order is never paid more than its total. Rows returned are overpaid orders.
select order_id, order_total, amount_paid
from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
where amount_paid > order_total + 0.01
